title: Great Britain Reach the Davis Cup Semi-Finals!
summary:
Great Britain are through to the Davis Cup semi-finals for the first time since 2019 — and it all came down to one exciting doubles match.

The Davis Cup is a team tennis contest. Countries play each other in singles and doubles matches.

Cameron Norrie gave Britain the lead by beating Jan-Lennard Struff in three sets. Then Alexander Zverev, the world number one, beat Arthur Fery 6-3, 6-2, so the tie was level.

That meant the doubles match would decide everything. Henry Patten and Neal Skupski beat Germany's Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz in Bologna on Thursday, November 26. The win meant a lot to Skupski: he had lost a Davis Cup quarter-final against the same German pair in December 2021.

Britain now face Spain in the semi-final on Saturday. Spain got there after Daniel Merida and Rafael Jodar won their singles matches.

It is a special moment for captain Leon Smith, who has led the team since 2010 and will step down at the end of the tournament. Britain have won the Davis Cup 10 times, most recently in 2015.
why_it_matters: It shows how teamwork can matter as much as individual skill, because Britain won through their doubles pair after the singles matches were shared.
